title: 第19章 唐山偷袭失败身份曝光遭围杀第20章 唐日天
lines: “暴杀！这才是暴杀，让那些赤霄剑阁的傻逼这么狂！”顾巧儿舞动着小拳头很是激动的说道。
她早看那般逼崽子不爽了，竟然还想拿下自己？真是搞笑，有两分实力就不知道自己几斤几两了。
“巧儿，别高兴的太早，你之后也是要面对他的，可千万要小心那人的手段！将眼泪作为武器，确实不凡！”
顾苍嘱咐道。
“知道啦，顾苍大哥，我不会忘记神子殿下的嘱托的。”
顾巧儿吐了吐舌头。
“果然不出神子殿下所料！”风霄第一个拍马屁。
“奇异步法、眼泪偷袭，此子的手段很是不凡啊。”顾远也称赞道。
“弊端在于只有第一次的时候格外有效，旁人一旦有了防备，效果就会大打折扣。”
“而且一旦踏入炼血，即便是洞穿心脏了，也不会立刻死亡。”白云帝分析起来：“但是确实是个可塑之才。”
“那白云帝，你觉得这般强者，为什么选择要穿黑衣，遮住面容？”
顾云忽然开口，嘴角淡笑。
“神子殿下的意思是……”
白云帝身为一国帝王，自然也是极其聪明之人。
只不过顾云已经不再言语，只待他自己思忖。
白云帝直接开启了头脑风暴，斩杀自己皇儿之人也是一位散修天骄，年龄定然不大，可是自己却苦寻不到。
“难不成！”一抹精光和杀机瞬间锁定在即将离开的唐山身上。
后者浑身一阵颤抖，只觉好像被什么洪水猛兽给盯上了。
该死，自己分明应该没有暴露才是。
但是在这天骄大战期间，饶是那白云帝的势力再大，也绝不敢对自己动手。
同他所想，白云帝的杀机仅仅持续了一瞬就消失了，无论如何，现在是天骄大战的现场，更有神子在场，若是动手那可就是事故了，赤发鬼的前车之鉴就在眼前，自己还是得沉得住气。
天骄之战依旧如火如荼进行着。
顾巧儿凭借炼血境的强大修为一路碾压，很快就进入了决赛。
而另外一方，正是刚刚斩杀蚩稔一鸣惊人的唐山。
两人一同站在了演武场上。
“没想到这个黑袍人竟然能一路走到决赛的舞台上，真的不简单啊。”
“可惜了，他的大部分手段在之前都已经施展过了，而现在这最后一场面对炼血境的顾家小公主，没有任何的胜算了。”
“我呸，一个只会搞些偷鸡摸狗的小动作的废物，也想要和顾家小公主比肩他也配？！”
在修炼界，这种暗箭伤人的手段虽然好用，但若是放在正规的演武台上使用那绝对是会受人诟病的。
毕竟这些年少轻狂的修士拼的就是个大开大合，强势碾压，你搞暗箭伤人那一套平日里也就算了，堂而皇之的使用被人瞧不起也是理所当然。
几乎没有人看好唐山。
但是唐山却不以为然。
content_en:
"Violent killing! This is violent killing, what makes those idiots from Chixiao Sword Pavilion so crazy!" Gu Qiaoer said excitedly, waving his little fists.
She has long been unhappy with such a pushover, but she still wants to take her down? It's really funny. If you have two points of strength, you don't know how much you weigh.
"Qiao'er, don't be too happy. You will have to face him later, but you must be careful of that person's methods! Using tears as a weapon is indeed extraordinary!"
Gu Cang instructed.
"I understand, Brother Gu Cang, I will never forget His Highness the Son of God's instructions."
Gu Qiaoer stuck out her tongue.
"As expected, His Highness the Son of God expected!" Feng Xiao was the first to flatter him.
"Strange footwork, tear attack, this kid's methods are very extraordinary." Gu Yuan also praised.
"The disadvantage is that it is only effective the first time. Once others are on guard, the effect will be greatly reduced."
"And once you step into blood refining, even if it pierces the heart, you will not die immediately." Emperor Baiyun analyzed: "But it is indeed a malleable talent."
"Then Emperor Baiyun, why do you think such a strong man chooses to wear black clothes and cover his face?"
Gu Yun suddenly spoke with a faint smile on his lips.
"His Royal Highness the Son of God means..."
As the emperor of a country, Emperor Baiyun was naturally an extremely smart person.
It's just that Gu Yun stopped talking and only let himself think.
Emperor Baiyun immediately started brainstorming. The person who killed his prince was also a genius of the non-religious cultivators. He must have been young, but he couldn't find him.
"Is it possible?" A flash of light and murderous intent instantly locked onto Tang Shan, who was about to leave.
The latter trembled all over, feeling as if he was being targeted by some ferocious beast.
Damn it, I obviously shouldn't have been exposed.
But during this Tianjiao war, no matter how powerful Baiyun Emperor was, he would never dare to take action against himself.
As he thought, Emperor Baiyun's murderous intention only lasted for a moment and then disappeared. In any case, now was the scene of the Tianjiao battle, and even the Son of God was present. If he took action, it would be an accident. The red-haired ghost's lesson was right in front of him, so he still had to calm down.
The war of genius is still in full swing.
Gu Qiaoer relied on her powerful cultivation in the blood refining realm to crush them all the way and quickly entered the finals.
On the other side, it was Tangshan who had just killed Chi Min and made a sensation.
The two stood on the martial arts field together.
"I didn't expect that this man in black robe could go all the way to the finals. It's really not easy."
"It's a pity that most of his methods have been used before, and now in this last battle against the little princess of the Gu family who is in the blood refining realm, she has no chance of winning."
"Bah, a loser who can only do some sneaky tricks, but he wants to be on par with the little princess of the Gu family. Is he worthy?!"
In the world of cultivation, although this method of stabbing people in the dark is easy to use, it will definitely be criticized if it is used on a regular martial arts stage.
After all, what these young and frivolous monks are trying to do is to attack with great force and crush them with force. You can just forget about the routine of hurting people with hidden arrows. It is natural for others to look down on you for using them openly.
Almost no one is optimistic about Tangshan.
But Tangshan disagreed.
title_en: Chapter 19: Tangshan’s failed sneak attack, identity exposed, and surrounded and killed Chapter 20: Tang Ritian
